name: Mad Alchemist
source: Kobold Quest From Ashes to Empire
book: Kobold Quest From Ashes to Empire

body:
MAD ALCHEMIST
CR 11

XP 12,800
CE large monstrous humanoid
Init +3, Senses Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 25, touch 13, flat-footed 22 (+3 Dex, +3 natural, +7 armor, +2 shield) (AC 29 with mutagen)
hp 157 (15d10 +75)
Fort +10, Ref +11 Will +11

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +2 corrosive scimitar +21/16/11 (1d6 +9 slashing +1d6 acid) or Bite +18/+13/+8 (2d6 +7 piercing plus venom) or Bombs +14/9/4 (due to the fast bomb discovery) (17 total bombs available)
Space 10 ft., Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks constrict 2d8 +7

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 16, Con 20, Int 22, Wis 14, Cha 11
Base Atk +11; CMB +19 (+23 grapple), CMD 32

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Creator (Ex)

Bombers will never attack the mad alchemist, but can still harm him with explosions.

Mutagen (Ex)

Drinking his mutagen grants the mad alchemist +6 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, a +4 bonus to natural armor (replacing his +3 bonus), -2 Wisdom, and invisibility as the spell.

Venom (Ex)

the mad alchemist has augmented his own form with elixirs to give himself a powerful venom.

Type poison (injury); save Fortitude DC 17; onset immediate; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds ; cure 2 consecutive saves 1d4 Constitution damage, 1d4 Strength damage.

Bombs (Ex)

As the alchemist ability. Damage equal to 6d6 +7 fire damage, and leave a grease slick upon detonation (due to the grease bomb discovery).
